TEXT.English: +1 food from tundra and snow tiles.
TEXT.French: +1 nourriture sur les cases de toundra et de neige.
TEXT.Italian: +1 cibo dalle caselle di tundra e neve.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 alimento en casillas de tundra y nieve.

TEXT.English: %s1_City has been destroyed by ice bears.
TEXT.French: %s1_City a été détruite par des ours polaires.
TEXT.Italian: %s1_City è stata distrutta dagli orsi polari.
TEXT.Spanish: %s1_City ha sido destruida por osos polares.

TEXT.English: Enters settled territory and destroys undefended cities. Cannot leave snow or tundra.
TEXT.French: Entre en territoire colonisé et détruit les villes sans défense. Ne peut quitter la neige ou la toundra.
TEXT.German: Betritt besiedeltes Gebiet und zerstört unverteidigte Städte. Kann Eis und Tundra nicht verlassen.
TEXT.Italian: Entra nei territori abitati e distrugge le città indifese. Non può lasciare neve o tundra.
TEXT.Spanish: Entra en territorio poblado y destruye ciudades indefensas. No puede abandonar nieve o tundra.

TEXT.English: The Power of the Frozen North
+1 production from sea tiles. Halved food in cities outside snow or tundra. Found cities on any snow or tundra tile. Units ignore snow damage.
TEXT.French: +1 production sur les cases marines. Nourriture divisée par deux dans les villes hors neige ou toundra. Fondez des villes sur toute case de neige ou de toundra. Les unités ignorent les dégâts de la neige.
TEXT.German: +1 Produktion auf Meeresfeldern. Halbierte Nahrung in Städten, die nicht in Eis oder Tundra liegen. Städte können auf beliebigen Eis- und Tundrafeldern gegründet werden. Einheiten erleiden keinen Eisschaden.
TEXT.Italian: +1 produzione dalle caselle marine. Cibo dimezzato nelle città fuori da neve o tundra. Fonda città su qualsiasi casella di neve o tundra. Le unità ignorano i danni della neve.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 producción en casillas marinas. Alimentos reducidos a la mitad en ciudades fuera de nieve o tundra. Funda ciudades en cualquier casilla de nieve o tundra. Las unidades ignoran el daño de la nieve.

TEXT.English: Win through the standard victory conditions.
TEXT.Italian: Vinci con le condizioni di vittoria normali.
TEXT.Spanish: Gana mediante las condiciones de victoria habituales.

TEXT.English: Snow deals 10 damage per turn, including in friendly territory. Eskimo units and animals are immune.
TEXT.French: La neige inflige 10 dégâts par tour, même en territoire ami. Les unités esquimaudes et les animaux sont immunisés.
TEXT.German: Schnee verursacht jede Runde 10 Schaden, auch in eigenem Gebiet. Eskimo-Einheiten und Tiere sind immun.
TEXT.Italian: La neve infligge 10 danni per turno, anche in territorio amico. Le unità eschimesi e gli animali sono immuni.
TEXT.Spanish: La nieve causa 10 de daño por turno, incluso en territorio amigo. Las unidades esquimales y los animales son inmunes.

TEXT.English: A fantastical umbrella civilization of Arctic communities. The Eskimos settle the frozen north, where Cooling houses sustain tundra and snow tiles. Sea tiles yield extra production, while cities outside snow or tundra produce half their normal food. Cities can be founded on any snow or tundra tile, with the normal minimum spacing. Astronomy reveals Hyperborea; Electricity reveals Agartha. These are fantasy identities, not historical claims about Arctic peoples.

TEXT.English: A powerful polar animal with strength 8. Ice bears remain on snow and tundra, even when attacking, and may enter settled cold territory. They seek cities within two tiles and destroy them once no defenders remain, without ever taking ownership. Their population is replenished throughout the game on empty cold land, including visible tiles, at least two tiles from owned territory (including diagonals). The No Barbarians option disables replenishment.

TEXT.English: Replaces the Scout and never becomes obsolete. 50% withdrawal chance against animals. Builds Hunting grounds and Deep archives; consumed on completion.
TEXT.French: Remplace l'Éclaireur et ne devient jamais obsolète. 50 % de chance de retraite contre les animaux. Construit des Terrains de chasse et des Archives profondes ; consommé à la fin.
TEXT.German: Ersetzt den Späher und bleibt immer baubar. 50% Rückzugschance gegen Tiere. Baut Jagdgründe und Tiefenarchive und wird dabei verbraucht.
TEXT.Italian: Sostituisce l'Esploratore e non diventa mai obsoleto. 50% di probabilità di ritirata contro gli animali. Costruisce Terreni di caccia e Archivi profondi; consumato al completamento.
TEXT.Spanish: Sustituye al Explorador y nunca queda obsoleto. 50% de probabilidad de retirada contra animales. Construye Cotos de caza y Archivos profundos; se consume al completarlos.

TEXT.English: Every two unimproved adjacent snow or tundra tiles add +1 food, production and commerce. Diagonals count; roads and peaks do not. Only Eskimos can use this tile.
TEXT.French: Deux cases adjacentes de neige ou toundra non aménagées ajoutent +1 nourriture, production et commerce. Diagonales incluses ; routes et sommets exclus. Réservé aux Esquimaux.
TEXT.German: Je zwei angrenzende unmodernisierte Eis- oder Tundrafelder geben +1 Nahrung, Produktion und Handel. Diagonalen zählen, Straßen und Berge nicht. Nur Eskimos können dieses Feld nutzen.
TEXT.Italian: Ogni due caselle adiacenti di neve o tundra non migliorate aggiungono +1 cibo, produzione e commercio. Diagonali incluse; strade e picchi esclusi. Solo per gli Eschimesi.
TEXT.Spanish: Cada dos casillas adyacentes de nieve o tundra sin mejorar añaden +1 alimento, producción y comercio. Cuentan las diagonales; caminos y picos excluidos. Solo para los esquimales.

TEXT.English: +3 research and +1 Great Scientist point when worked. Other civilizations receive +5 research and no points. Requires snow hills.
TEXT.French: +3 recherche et +1 point de savant illustre si exploité. Les autres civilisations reçoivent +5 recherche sans points. Nécessite une colline enneigée.
TEXT.German: Bei Bearbeitung +3 Forschung und +1 Wissenschaftlerpunkt. Andere Zivilisationen erhalten +5 Forschung ohne Punkte. Nur auf Eishügeln.
TEXT.Italian: +3 ricerca e +1 punto Grande Scienziato se lavorato. Le altre civiltà ricevono +5 ricerca senza punti. Richiede colline innevate.
TEXT.Spanish: +3 investigación y +1 punto de Gran Científico al trabajarlo. Otras civilizaciones reciben +5 investigación sin puntos. Requiere colinas nevadas.

TEXT.English: Next to sea or lake tiles: +1 food and +2 commerce.
TEXT.French: Près de la mer ou des lacs : +1 nourriture et +2 commerce.
TEXT.German: Neben Meer oder See +1 Nahrung und +2 Handel.
TEXT.Italian: Accanto a mare o laghi: +1 cibo e +2 commercio.
TEXT.Spanish: Junto al mar o lagos: +1 alimento y +2 comercio.

TEXT.English: Eskimo replacement for the Scout, with recon promotions. Strength 2, cost 30, available from the start. Has no upgrade successors and remains trainable in every era, even when ordinary Scouts would be obsolete. Can attack and has 50% extra withdrawal against animals; when defending, withdrawal leaves it on its current tile. Can establish Hunting grounds from Hunting and Deep archives from Mining. The hunter is consumed only when construction finishes. Ordinary Workers cannot create these improvements.

TEXT.English: Built by an Arctic hunter on flat snow or tundra. Every two adjacent neighbours contribute +1 food, +1 production and +1 commerce if each is snow or tundra, has neither an improvement nor any road or railroad, and is not a peak or city. All eight surrounding tiles count, including diagonals. Odd neighbour counts are rounded down. Neighbour ownership and features do not matter. Changes to neighbours update the yield immediately. Other civilizations receive no yields at all from the Hunting grounds tile.

TEXT.English: Built by an Arctic hunter from Mining, only on snow hills. A city working the tile receives 3 direct research and one Great Scientist point per turn if Eskimo; other civilizations receive 5 research and no Great Person points. These are research points, independent of the research slider, and ordinary city research and Great Person modifiers apply. Each archive needs a working citizen; an overlapping city cannot collect its effects a second time.
